不需要任何编程或算法基础。机器人在表上一格一格地算，你接出它每一格跑的电路板，再: No programming or algorithms background needed. A robot works across a table cell by cell; you wire the board it runs on every cell, then use a finished board as a part.
把两条来路的数加起来；「起点」口是「是」时，再加 1。: Adds up the numbers on its two ways in, plus 1 when its “start” port is “yes”.
机器人在每一格上运行同一块电路板；拼好的电路板会变成元件。: On every cell the robot runs the same circuit board, and a finished board becomes a component.
一格的规则：只接一次，机器人在每一格上都运行它。: The rule for one cell: wired once, the robot runs it on every cell.
点一格，接一根线: Click a cell, wire it in
机器人一格一格地走过整张表，在每一格上运行同一块<wiki-ref to=\"b: The robot walks through the whole table cell by cell and runs the same <wiki-ref to="board"></wiki-ref> on every cell.
让机器人把最左边格子里的数一格一格抄到最右边。: Have the robot copy the number in the leftmost cell, cell by cell, all the way to the right.
在视野里点「左边」，把它连到「本格」。: Click “left” in the view and wire it to “this cell”.
电路板就是规则：只写一次，机器人在每一格上都用它。: The circuit board is the rule: you write it once, and the robot uses it on every cell.
在视野里点「左边」，再连到「本格」。: Click “left” in the view, then wire it to “this cell”.
把两个数汇进一个元件: Merge two numbers in one component
汇合器把几根线送来的数加起来，「—」不参与。: A Merger adds up the numbers its wires bring; “—” is left out.
起点已经写好 1。让机器人算出每个路口的路线数：上面 + 左边。: The start already holds 1. Have the robot work out the routes to every crossing: up + left.
把「上面」和「左边」都接进一个汇合器，再接到「本格」。: Wire “up” and “left” into one Merger, then the Merger to “this cell”.
第一次往板上放元件：元件放在输入和输出之间，几条来路收成一个数: the first part placed on a board: it sits between the inputs and the output and gathers several ways in into one number
你只接了三根线，机器人就把整座城市填满了。: You drew three wires and the robot filled in the whole city.
两个输入都接进同一个汇合器。: Wire both inputs into the same Merger.
在元件外面加一道闸: Add a gate outside the part
路线不能经过石头：石头格的路线数是「—」。: Routes can’t pass through rocks: a rock cell has “—” routes.
数出每个路口的路线数，石头格不算。: Count the routes to every crossing, rock cells left out.
用路线计数器数，拦截闸在石头格拦下结果。: Count with the Route Counter, and block the result on rock cells.
元件不用改，外面加一道闸就够了。: The part stays as it is; a gate outside it is enough.
「是石头」接拦截闸的条件口，路线计数器接数口。: Wire “is rock” to the Block gate’s condition and the Route Counter into its number.
汇合两条来路，认出起点: Merge two ways in, spot the start
街道只能往右或往下走。每个路口的路线数 = 上面 + 左边，起点是 1。: Streets only go right or down. The routes to a crossing = up + left, and the start is 1.
让机器人在起点写 1，其余每个路口 = 上面 + 左边。: Have the robot write 1 on the start and up + left on every other crossing.
汇合器收上面和左边；放行闸只在起点放一个 1 进去。: A Merger takes up and left; a Pass gate lets a 1 in at the start only.
这块板从此是一个元件：路线计数器。: From now on this board is a part: the Route Counter.
「是起点」接放行闸的条件口，常数 1 接数口，再把放行闸接进汇合器。: Wire “is start” to the Pass gate’s condition and a Constant 1 to its number, then the gate into the Merger.
